description: This file is a PHP source code defining a Smarty plugin modifier called strip_tags, which is used to compile code that strips HTML tags from text. It contains a single function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_strip_tags' that generates code to either use 'preg_replace' or PHP's 'strip_tags' based on parameters.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_strip_tags
methods.description: Compiles a Smarty template modifier that strips HTML tags from a string, either by generating code with 'preg_replace' or by calling PHP's 'strip_tags' function, based on input parameters.
